name: Cimmerian-Palimpsest
description: The sea here is thick with dissolved metals, so sunsets burn green and gold above the waves. Beneath them wait frozen methane lakes, and everything the light never reaches.
The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking.
Geologists argue about the strata here: several layers appear deposited out of order, as if the planet's history were shuffled like cards.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
